prompt: Write a test file for the attached hover.ts using node:test (describe/it) and node:assert/strict, importing from ./hover.ts. Output ONE fenced ts code block headed by a line // hover.test.ts. Use a fake timer object implementing HoverTimers: a monotonically increasing id, a list of pending callbacks with due times, and an advance(ms) helper that fires due callbacks in order. Record every onChange(open, by) call in an array. Required tests: (1) pointerEnter opens nothing before 300 ms and opens by hover at 300 ms; (2) pointerLeave before 300 ms cancels the open; (3) pointerLeave on the open card closes after 150 ms, not before; (4) popoverEnter during the grace cancels the close and popoverLeave schedules it again; (5) focus opens at once with by focus; (6) blur closes at once; (7) blur does not close while holdForFocus is active, and closeNow still closes and clears the hold; (8) escape closes at once and cancels pending timers; (9) moving the pointer from card a to card b: a stays open until b opens, then only b is open (onChange sequence ends with b); (10) click opens at once with by click; (11) dispose cancels pending timers (advance afterwards produces no onChange). Keep each test short.

Write a test file for the attached edge-geom.ts using node:test (describe/it) and node:assert/strict, importing from ./edge-geom.ts. Pt is {x:number,y:number}; Rect is {x,y,w,h}. Output ONE fenced ts code block headed by a line // edge-geom.test.ts. Required tests: roundedPath of an empty or one-point list is the empty string; a straight two-point route is M..L.. with no Q; an L-shaped three-point route contains exactly one Q and starts at the first point and ends at the last; the corner radius shrinks on a short segment (a 4 px segment gives control points no more than 2 px from the corner); arrowPath ends at the last point (its middle L is the last point) and its two arms are 7 px long by default for a horizontal and for a vertical final segment; segmentsOf drops zero-length segments and flags horizontal; placeEdgeLabel centres on the longest horizontal segment, returns null when the longest segment is shorter than the text plus 16, places beside a vertical segment with the plate starting 6 px minus 2 right of the line (x = line + 4), skips a candidate that hits an obstacle and tries the next longest segment, and returns null when all candidates hit obstacles.
